Ascertainment: Systematic: dysmorphology evaluation by a paediatrician, double blind, of a selected 163 infants plus same-day controls

Notes: Only the 163 selected infants (heavy drinkers, light drinkers and controls) were examined, not all 1,529 births; both FAS cases were in the heavy-drinker group
